title: My parents had an intervention
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: This is a story, not a lesson. Read it and think about what people thought of a plan of yours.

Jose said: look, it is my whole life story, not to talk about myself. When I first started buying land in a little fishing village in the middle of nowhere, my parents called my sister, and they had an intervention.

They said: we need to tell Jose to go to a psychologist, because he is leaving his city job, his city company. He is folding it up and going to a small fishing village that is fifty years away from anything happening.
There were dirt roads, he said, and nobody there, and one hotel with ten rooms. That is all there was.
And I was like: no, it is going to happen.
So it is a lonely world as an entrepreneur, he said, when you believe in something.
What do the people closest to you say about your plan?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write one plan of yours that people doubted.
Write what you believed, and what you did.

check.q: Who called Jose's sister, in his story?
What did they want Jose to do?
What did Jose say to himself about it?

recap: When people doubt you, check your evidence and keep going.
